purpose: preregistered prospective paired test of whether explicit context/memory refresh changes conversation-scoped callable-tool binding

hypotheses.H1: explicit context/memory refresh can alter conversation-scoped callable-tool registration/binding
hypotheses.H2: binding failures occur independently of refresh
hypotheses.H3: only discovery/presentation state changes while direct dispatch remains callable
hypotheses.H4: local MCP/Tailscale/backend transport causes the observed failures

canaries.action: call alternate busy_list or harmless process echo
record local server request_start/caller evidence when available

recovery_limit: maximum one rediscovery after failure; no extra retries

decision_rule.support_H1: clean treatment changes callability relative to its immediately preceding baseline while controls remain stable, preferably across at least 2 independent paired conversations
decision_rule.weaken_H1: clean control and treatment failure rates are indistinguishable or failures occur before treatment
decision_rule.single_occurrence: reproduction only, not a general causal estimate
